terms.p: A code block in a documentation comment, which cargo test extracts, compiles as a separate crate against your library, and executes.
A test written in a child module beside the code, which can therefore reach private items the rest of the world cannot.
A test in the tests directory, compiled as its own crate, which can only reach what your library makes public.
The hidden entry point the compiler builds from every function marked with the test attribute, which runs them in parallel and reports the results.

terms.x: assert a law, not an example
terms.p: Testing by stating a rule that should hold for every input and letting a tool search for a counterexample, then shrink it to the smallest case that still fails.
